_comment: Live-data provider policy. Values marked *_unconfirmed are placeholders pending the discovery-report operator gates (tasks 2.3/4.3/5.3) — adapters refuse to serve an operation whose envelope is unconfirmed. Quota design target: TaoStats FREE tier; self-cap strictly below the provider 5/min (operator refinement 2026-07-12). Window kind starts at the stricter 'month' reading until discovery confirms day-vs-month.

quota.per_minute_cap_unconfirmed: proposed self-cap below provider 5/min — operator gate 5.3
quota.window_kind_unconfirmed: day vs month confirmed by discovery (task 4.1)

endpoints._comment: Filled from approved discovery reports (gates 2.3/4.3). Shape per operation: provider, path, params, schema, freshness envelope {max_upstream_age_s, max_local_age_s, expected_cadence}.
